info.title: CampusOS API
info.description: Student-focused campus platform API. Use the Authorize button to add your JWT token for protected endpoints.

tags.name: Clubs & Memberships
tags.description: Endpoints for student clubs, organizations, and membership management

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Endpoints for campus event management and registration

tags.name: Announcements
tags.description: Campus announcement management and read tracking

tags.name: Opportunities
tags.description: Student internships, competitions, scholarships, and opportunities

tags.name: Lost & Found
tags.description: Student Lost & Found item listings and status tracking

tags.name: Campus Help Desk
tags.description: Campus issue reporting, tracking, assignment, and resolution

tags.name: Resource Hub - Resources
tags.description: Academic resource management (notes, papers, assignments, etc.)

get.description: Returns the logged-in user's profile

put.description: Updates the logged-in user's profile. All fields optional.
Updates a resource. Uploader or ADMIN only.

delete.description: Deletes a resource. Uploader or ADMIN only.

get.description: Fetch details of a single opportunity.

put.description: Update an opportunity. Restricted to creating CLUB_ADMIN or ADMIN.

delete.description: Delete an opportunity. Restricted to creating CLUB_ADMIN or ADMIN.

get.description: Fetch details of a single lost/found item.

put.description: Update details of a listing. Restricted to owner or ADMIN.

delete.description: Delete a listing. Restricted to owner or ADMIN.

get.description: Fetch details of an issue. Restricted to reporter, assigned staff, or ADMIN.

put.description: Update issue details. Reporter can only update while status is SUBMITTED. ADMIN can update anytime.

delete.description: Delete issue. Reporter can only delete while status is SUBMITTED. ADMIN can delete anytime.

get.description: Returns details for a specific event.

put.description: Updates event details. Restricted to event creator, club admin, and ADMIN.

delete.description: Soft-cancels an event and all its registrations. Restricted to event creator, club admin, and ADMIN.

get.description: Returns details for a specific club.

put.description: Updates club details. Restricted to the club creator and ADMIN.

delete.description: Soft-deactivates a club. Restricted to the club creator and ADMIN.

put.description: Updates membership status (APPROVED or REJECTED). Restricted to club admin and ADMIN.
Updates an announcement. Creator or ADMIN only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an announcement. Creator or ADMIN only.

get.description: Returns subjects. Optional: filter by courseId and/or semester.

post.description: Creates a new subject in a course. ADMIN only.

get.description: Returns paginated resources. Optional filters: subjectId, resourceType, search.

post.description: Uploads a new academic resource. CLUB_ADMIN and ADMIN only.

get.description: Returns active opportunities (status OPEN and deadline not expired). Nearest deadline first by default.

post.description: Create a new opportunity. Restricted to CLUB_ADMIN and ADMIN.

get.description: Returns paginated items. Default feed shows OPEN and MATCHED, sorted by createdAt DESC.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search across title, description, itemType, location

post.description: Report a lost or found item. Reporter is set to current user.

get.description: Returns issues prioritized by URGENT -> HIGH -> MEDIUM -> LOW, then newest. Restricted to ADMIN.

post.description: Submit a campus issue. Initial status is SUBMITTED.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of events with search, category, status, location, and date filters.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term in title or description

post.description: Creates a new campus event. Restricted to CLUB_ADMIN and ADMIN.
Registers the current user for an event. Returns CONFIRMED or WAITLISTED status.

delete.description: Cancels the current user's event registration. Promotes waitlisted users if applicable.

get.description: Returns all departments sorted by name.

post.description: Creates a new academic department. ADMIN only.

get.description: Returns courses. Optional: filter by departmentId.

post.description: Creates a new course in a department. ADMIN only.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of clubs with search and filtering.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term in name or description

post.description: Creates a new club organization. Restricted to CLUB_ADMIN and ADMIN.
Submits a membership request for a club. Status will be PENDING.
Creates a new student account. Returns a JWT token on success.
Authenticate with email and password. Returns a JWT token. Rate limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP.

get.description: Returns paginated announcements. Default: ACTIVE only, pinned first. Supports search, category, status, pinned filters.

post.description: Creates a new announcement. Restricted to CLUB_ADMIN and ADMIN.
Marks an announcement as read for the current user.

patch.description: Update status according to allowed workflow transitions (OPEN -> MATCHED -> RECOVERED -> CLOSED). Restricted to owner or ADMIN.
ADMIN can update to any valid status. Reporter can close their own RESOLVED issue.
Mark issue as RESOLVED with resolution notes. Restricted to ADMIN.
Assign issue to staff/user and move status to IN_PROGRESS. Restricted to ADMIN.
Toggles the pinned status of an announcement.
Archives an announcement, hiding it from the default feed.

get.description: Returns issues submitted by the currently logged-in user.
Returns the current user's event registrations, filterable by status.
Returns the current user's unread active announcements, pinned first.
Returns all registrations for an event. Restricted to event creator, club admin, and ADMIN.
Returns a paginated list of approved club members.
Returns pending join requests. Restricted to club admin and ADMIN.

Bearer Authentication.description: Paste your JWT token here (without the 'Bearer ' prefix)
